title: AF-action groupoid models for diagonal AH-algebras
summary: We show that an inductive AH-system with diagonal connecting maps describes an action of the canonical AF-groupoid on the spectrum of the canonical C$^*$-diagonal, and that the canonical groupoid model is given by the transformation groupoid associated to this action. This divides the groupoid structure into two distinct aspects: the acting AF-groupoid (which is well-studied) and the unit space on which it acts.
